title: The folk concept of consciousness may come unstuck, as phlogiston and the crystal spheres did

statements.text: Entrenched concepts sometimes come unstuck under empirical and theoretical pressure, as the crystal spheres, daemonic possession, phlogiston and the ether did. The same fate may befall the concept of consciousness, and the erosion of its traditional conception by empirical findings, its transparency, its unity and its tie to language, is greater than usually reckoned.

sources.quote: The theme of this paper is that a similar fate may befall concepts respected and revered in our own prevailing conception of how humans works, and the concept on which I mean to focus is consciousness.
But the extent of the erosion of the concept by recent empirical findings is, I suspect, greater than hitherto reckoned.
